snippet.title: Celeste Fusion Collab | Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Vote for Fusion Collab in this poll! - https://strawpoll.com/PKgleJVW9Zp

The Celeste Fusion Collab is a map pack mod for the game Celeste that has been in development for a few months now. 
The map pack will feature over 100 maps, and a unique gimmick: Fusion! Maps will come in trios- complete 2 base maps, and unlock a third map- the fusion of the two! 
This Collab will include not only over 100 maps, but also hours of custom music, many new custom coded entities, a vast showcase of amazing custom artwork, and more! 

The mod will be free to download for anyone who owns a modable copy of Celeste, sometime in the future! We hope you will enjoy the collaborative project we are working so hard on!

For more information on release dates and progress, please join the official Celeste Discord at https:/discord.gg/celeste

Thumbnail by nerferd
Music by Abicus Null and Catapillie
Trailer Edited by Nyan
